questions.question: Does the styled corpus bind against the plain corpus on both of Gareth’s designated chat-prefill and paraphrase halves?

labels.binds: Styled exceeds plain by at least 0.5 nats on chat-prefill and at least 0.3 on paraphrase.
labels.does_not_bind: Styled exceeds plain by less than 0.3 nats on both chat-prefill and paraphrase.

questions.question: Does the Kaggle trainer pass the update-0 NLL and fall-ratio reproduction gate?

labels.pass: Update-0 NLL is within 0.02 of Tinker and fall ratio is within 0.97–1.15, inclusive.
labels.gate_failed: Update-0 NLL is off by more than 0.02 or fall ratio lies outside 0.97–1.15.
